caption: The reference note stores the citekey, local PDF and offset.
The command opens the local PDF at physical page 1.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['local-citation-page-jump']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.referenceFolder = 'Local Citation Page Jump/References'; const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); await leaf.setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: 'Local Citation Page Jump/Manuscript.md', mode: 'source' } }); const editor = leaf.view.editor; const lines = editor.getValue().split('\n'); const n = lines.findIndex((s) => s.includes("[@Lee2020, p. 44]")); if (n < 0) throw new Error('Missing citation'); editor.setCursor({ line: n, ch: lines[n].indexOf("[@Lee2020, p. 44]") + 2 }); const deadline = Date.now() + 10000; while (!p.references().some((r) => r.citekey === 'Lee2020') || p.references().filter((r) => r.citekey === 'Dup2020').length !== 2) { if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error('Reference cache not ready'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const result = await p.runCitation(editor, false); return JSON.stringify(result); })()
